alternativeSelection.assessment: Three coherent and feasible business responses are supported: international management, responsible enterprise/environmental assessment and technical business analytics. Their six/nine/eleven different courses follow those organising priorities. Optional external minors support study directions within 30 EC of open study; no minor certificate or automatic thesis entry is certified. All 46 exact-target interests are assessed; entrepreneurship/innovation is already in the closest core and illustrative/career items generate no further option.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both introduce entrepreneurship and business organisations; Radboud puts international context at the centre.
Both teach marketing decisions and engagement with consumers; Radboud also integrates strategy.
Both analyse the functioning of organisations; UCR emphasises psychology of leadership.
Both consider creating value through enterprise; UCR’s team product design includes explicit sustainability analysis.
Both address people in organisations;UCR studies inclusive leadership,emotion regulation andpsychologicalsafety with empiricalsurveyresearch,not the full strategicHRM toolkit.
Both examine digital technologies,innovation andorganisational value creation;UCR concentrates onAIbusiness/economic/governance cases,not the whole innovation-management field.
Distinct organisation/job-design principles;leadership andgeneralstrategy do not establish the same design training.
No included UCR course teaches the defining global-value-chain framework, upgrading trajectories and trade-data mapping. International business supplies related trade and governance study separately.

Both directly analyse cross-border business environments, country attractiveness, internationalisation and market-entry strategy. UCR includes trade and governance; this is a partial relationship, not the full Radboud strategy course.

Consumer research is a genuine UCR contribution, but its description does not establish Radboud’s broader international marketing theories, branding and cultural analysis. The UCR marketing course is already represented once at the introductory component.

Both address strategic choices and organisational transformation under technological and market change. UCR develops a strategic plan and responsible digital transformation; it does not reproduce Radboud’s full advanced strategy framework.
Organisationalchange cases andprocess theory are distinct from personalleadership;other partlyrelated managementcourses are alreadyplaced once.
No scheduled UCR course directly covers the specifically credited System Theory component at comparable scope; it remains distinct.
Both introduce economic reasoning for business settings.
Both teach financial/managementaccounting,statements,control andperformance;UCR also teaches investmentappraisal. They do not have identical creditweight orscope.

Both teach valuation of financial assets, risk/return and financial instruments. UCR centres banking and monetary institutions; Radboud additionally requires corporate capital structure, capital budgeting and project-investment decisions. This is a bounded subject relationship, not full corporate-finance equivalence.
Both develop source evaluation,academicwriting,literature synthesis andresearchquestions;UCR adds personal/civicdevelopment,whileRadboud culminates in a reviewstudy.
Both develop quantitative research design and statistical analysis.
Both teach qualitative social research methods applicable to organisations.

Both develop practical statistical analysis, interpretation and reporting of quantitative research. UCR supplies multivariable methods in health and behavioural research; Radboud applies methods to business and announces exact topics before the course. No identical technique list or syllabus is assumed.
No scheduled UCR course directly covers the specifically credited Bachelor’s Thesis IBA component at comparable scope; it remains distinct.
Responsible-business management integrates social,environmental andeconomicvalue;public sustainabilitygovernance is a contextual complement,not the same primary organisational-management inquiry.

AI Ethics examines ethical frameworks and AI’s social effects. That supports the digital-business option but does not establish this course’s analytical and continental philosophical study of corporate ethics.
An integrated responsible-organisation analysis project is distinct from alreadyplaced generalmethods/statistics andselfleadership.
No scheduled UCR course directly covers the specifically credited Flexibility window component at comparable scope; it remains distinct.

notes.text: The UCR alternatives can share international strategy, marketing, economics, organisational behaviour and business research with Radboud while concentrating differently on sustainable enterprise or technical analytics. Radboud’s prescribed Global Value Chains, Systems Theory and independent IBA thesis remain separate requirements; the 30-EC third-year flexibility window is genuine choice space.

audience.programmeDescription: International Business Administration studies how organisations operate across borders and respond to economic, social and environmental change. It combines management, marketing, finance and organisational research with responsible enterprise.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The three UCR options pursue international management, responsible enterprise with environmental science, or business decisions with technical data analysis. They retain substantial business study and research methods. They do not reproduce the full global-value-chain, organisation-design, systems-theory, international-marketing or independent-thesis sequence. The published IBA subjects support this academic comparison, while conflicting thesis-entry rules prevent certification of the external pathway.

curriculum.limitation: The 25 published components total 180 EC. The adopted regulations require 90 EC and older methods preparation for the IBA thesis, while its current catalogue requires 102 EC and named renewed courses. The controlling relationship and thesis eligibility remain unverified.

componentNotes.y3-thesis: Required 12-EC individual research project. The adopted regulations require at least 90 EC and Academic Skills, Statistics and Methods of Research and Intervention. The current catalogue instead requires 102 EC, Academic Skills, Quantitative Methods 1 and Sustainable Entrepreneurship. Formal eligibility remains unverified.
componentNotes.y3-flex: 30 EC open study. An optional 18-EC minor, approved exchange, or a permitted 6-, 12- or 24-EC internship may form part of this space. External courses need approval and must avoid overlap.
componentNotes.y1-academic: Required 6-EC course. First-year students also take the linked academic English language assessment; it adds no extra EC.
componentNotes.y2-design: Required 6-EC course with an attendance condition.
componentNotes.y3-systems: Required 6-EC course with an attendance condition.

comparisonScope.label: Qualified academic comparison
comparisonScope.assessed: The confirmed English-taught IBA curriculum in the 2026–2027 regulations: 25 published components totalling 180 EC, including 30 EC of open study and a 12-EC individual thesis.
comparisonScope.excluded: Certification of ordinary thesis eligibility, reconciliation of the 90/102-EC and old/new methods requirements, waivers and automatic completion of an optional external minor.

acceptance.claim: The confirmed IBA subjects support meaningful comparisons with three distinct complete UCR business responses, without certifying a formally eligible external progression pathway.
acceptance.targetContext: CP053: English-taught International Business Administration specialisation of the ordinary full-time Radboud BSc Bedrijfskunde (50645); current 2026–2027 adopted OER; renewed programme since 2024–2025. No optional minor is made compulsory.
acceptance.challengeMethod: Separately identified same-AI source-first second pass against current official PDF/API content, actual UCR evidence and exact finished inputs; no independent human or separate-agent review.

uncertainties.fact: The 25 published components total 180 EC. The adopted regulations require 90 EC and older methods preparation for the IBA thesis, while its current catalogue requires 102 EC and named renewed courses. The controlling relationship and thesis eligibility remain unverified.

adverseResolutions.resolution: A current amendment gives precedence to the 102-EC catalogue rule or recognizes renewed preparation.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: The confirmed subjects and three UCR responses remain. No precedence or equivalence is assumed.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The 90-EC formal rule and legacy Methods of Research and Intervention preparation remain applicable, requiring additional preparation or a different approved sequence.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: Formal thesis access could change. The known international management, organisation and methods core still supports the narrower academic claim. No premaster-only module, waiver or extra credit is inserted.
